verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own docs say checks can be forwarded by mail directly to your bank of deposit, for an additional fee, so the founder never handles the paper. But this is physical forwarding to the bank rather than the provider endorsing and depositing the check itself, and there is no evidence of reconciliation. Missing for 10: provider-side endorsement, direct or electronic deposit, reconciliation or deposit confirmation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
